question: From which knot do the three referenced elements extend in this teaching?
premises: The reference point is the brahma knot
There are three elements extending from it
inference: Three elements are situated extending from the brahma knot.
uncertainties: The referent of etāṃ and trīṇi depends on surrounding context
plain_english: Situated from the brahma knot, these are indeed three, O beautiful-faced one.
